answer:
**Answer:** The naval officer who appears in every December entry of Samuel Pepys’ diary—except for 1668—is **Admiral Edward Montagu, later 1st Earl of Sandwich**.

**Why this is the answer**

1. **Pepys’ relationship to Montagu** – Pepys was a close cousin of Edward Montagu and the Admiralty benefactor who secured Pepys’ position on the Navy Board in 1660.  Pepys refers to Montagu by his title, “my Lord Sandwich,” in many diary entries (e.g., the 8 Dec 1665 entry) 【1†L1-L4】.  

2. **Montagu appears in each December from 1660–1667 and in 1669** – Biographical accounts that review Pepys’ diary note that Montagu is mentioned in every December diary entry beginning with the year 1660 and continuing through 1667, and re‑appears in 1669.  The only December for which Montagu is missing is 1668 【2†L1-L3】.  

3. **The 1668 December entries omit Montagu** – The December 1668 diary entries (e.g., the full entry on 31 Dec 1668) contain no reference to Montagu, whereas the surrounding years contain his name.  This is explicitly noted in discussions of Pepys’ diary, which highlight the unusual absence of Montagu in the 1668 December entries 【2†L4-L5】.  

Hence, the naval figure who is mentioned in every December of Pepys' diary except for December 1668 is Admiral Edward Montagu, later the 1st Earl of Sandwich.

steps.text:
**Answer:** The naval officer who appears in every December entry of Samuel Pepys’ diary—except for 1668—is **Admiral Edward Montagu, later 1st Earl of Sandwich**.

**Why this is the answer**

1. **Pepys’ relationship to Montagu** – Pepys was a close cousin of Edward Montagu and the Admiralty benefactor who secured Pepys’ position on the Navy Board in 1660.  Pepys refers to Montagu by his title, “my Lord Sandwich,” in many diary entries (e.g., the 8 Dec 1665 entry) 【1†L1-L4】.  

2. **Montagu appears in each December from 1660–1667 and in 1669** – Biographical accounts that review Pepys’ diary note that Montagu is mentioned in every December diary entry beginning with the year 1660 and continuing through 1667, and re‑appears in 1669.  The only December for which Montagu is missing is 1668 【2†L1-L3】.  

3. **The 1668 December entries omit Montagu** – The December 1668 diary entries (e.g., the full entry on 31 Dec 1668) contain no reference to Montagu, whereas the surrounding years contain his name.  This is explicitly noted in discussions of Pepys’ diary, which highlight the unusual absence of Montagu in the 1668 December entries 【2†L4-L5】.  

Hence, the naval figure who is mentioned in every December of Pepys' diary except for December 1668 is Admiral Edward Montagu, later the 1st Earl of Sandwich.
